name: context-heat
description: Background blocks that stack up and warm toward 600k context tokens, plus a row that says whether work is still running.

backdrop.title: backdrop
backdrop.description: Faint blocks behind the conversation in the desktop app that stack up as the context fills.

dots.title: dots
dots.description: The strip of 240 dots across the row, one for every 2.5k tokens.

contextFigure.title: contextFigure
contextFigure.description: The context figure on the right of the row, for example "362k of 600k".

workStatus.title: workStatus
workStatus.description: "Working: ..." or "Idle: nothing running" on the left of the row.

backgroundTasks.title: backgroundTasks
backgroundTasks.description: Counts background commands and workflows as work ("1 command running"). Shows only with workStatus.

countdown.title: countdown
countdown.description: The countdown from Claude's "Estimate: N minutes", for example "6:40 left of 10 min".

estimateNote.title: estimateNote
estimateNote.description: A short note on each prompt asking Claude to state an estimate. Only added while countdown or notifications is on, since nothing else reads the estimate.

handoffWarning.title: handoffWarning
handoffWarning.description: At 600k: the status line entry, the figure in the warning colour and the slow pulse of the background.

redPastLimit.title: redPastLimit
redPastLimit.description: From 600k to 750k the dots and background blocks deepen to dark red.

handoffNudge.title: handoffNudge
handoffNudge.description: Once per session at 585k, a notice to run /handoff; also adds the /handoff command.

cacheTimer.title: cacheTimer
cacheTimer.description: "Cache warm", then "Cache cold in m:ss", then "Cache cold", on a small line under the row.

compactionCount.title: compactionCount
compactionCount.description: "Compacted 2 times" on the small line under the row; hidden until the first compaction.

waitingOnYou.title: waitingOnYou
waitingOnYou.description: The row turns amber and says "Waiting on you" while a question or a permission prompt is open.

notifications.title: notifications
notifications.description: A system notification when a session is done, or starts waiting on you. Not for turns under 30 seconds.

agentList.title: agentList
agentList.description: "N agents running" opens a list of the agents with a countdown each. Shows only with workStatus.

sleepFix.title: sleepFix
sleepFix.description: Leaves out time the Mac sleeps or the app is closed, and clears stale work after a restart.
